title: Tending quality is distinct from infection and surgery conditions
summary: Tend quality, treatment speed, infection chance and surgery success depend on different factors.
body: The Medical Tend Quality stat depends on medical skill, manipulation and sight, with role and bed effects. A normal bed does not itself improve tend quality. Lighting affects tending speed and surgery rather than this quality stat; cleanliness and indoors affect infection/surgery rather than directly improving the stat. Inspect the doctor, medicine and patient conditions. Treatment having been ordered is not evidence that a wound is tended, immunity is ahead, or the patient is recovered.
